headline: Congress named a Battle Creek, Michigan postal facility the Sojourner Truth Post Office.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 90 McCamly Street South in Battle Creek, Michigan, as the Sojourner Truth Post Office. It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on October 1, 2024.
